t: A small republic built a trading empire across four continents through the VOC and the West India Company.
The VOC's permanent capital and tradable shares created a model of the joint-stock company still recognisable today.
Weakened by wars with Britain, the VOC was dissolved in 1799; Indonesian independence in 1949 ended its Asian empire.
dyk: Hugo Grotius wrote Mare Liberum (1609) in defence of the VOC, and it became a founding text of international law.
ev: The States-General merges rival traders into the VOC with quasi-sovereign powers
Jan Pieterszoon Coen founds Batavia on Java
The VOC captures Malacca from Portugal
Jan van Riebeeck founds the Cape Colony as a VOC resupply station
England takes New Netherland and New Amsterdam
The VOC is formally dissolved and its debts pass to the Dutch state
Japan conquers the Netherlands East Indies in about three months
Suriname's independence ends the Dutch colonial empire
